verdict.rationale: Martin's own email triage background task automatically labels incoming emails and takes follow-up actions, which is event-triggered automation. The docs never show users defining their own trigger→action rules. Custom shortcuts trigger multi-step actions only when the user invokes them, and briefings and wake-up calls run on recurring schedules rather than reacting to events. Missing for 10: user-definable rule configuration (conditions/triggers), event triggers beyond incoming email, documented rule-engine depth, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Martin can automatically label your emails and take follow up actions on your behalf.
